# Lego Batman: The Videogame

## What items and locations are shuffled?
- Level Unlocks
- Minikts
- Power Brick Purchases
- Hostages
- True Super
- Characters
- Suits

## Is this game compatible with Universal Tracker and does it have a map tracker?
Yes, this game is compatible with Universal Tracker's yamless generation and its /explain function for logic. There is a map pack in progress.

## How do I goal in the game?
Once you meet your goal condition, go to the minikit display room and your wincon will be checked.

## Will there be GOG support?
Yes, GOG support is planned, but will require us to adjust how things are handled so it won't be in the near future.

## How do I report bugs?
Please report bugs in the discord thread. Include as much detail as possible so we can recreate the issue.

tutorials.text:
# SETUP GUIDE FOR Lego Batman The Videogame
- --
## Required software
- An unmodified copy of the Steam release of Lego Batman
- A copy of the APWorld (requires Archipelago version 0.6.7 or higher)
- Reloaded II Mod Loader [Link](https://reloaded-project.github.io/Reloaded-II/QuickStart)
  - Requires .NET 9.0 or higher
- The Lego Batman Archipelago Mod [Link](https://github.com/jradcode23/LB1_AP_Mod/releases)
- --
## Optional Software
- DXWnd [Link](https://sourceforge.net/projects/dxwnd/)
- --
## First Time Setup 
- Install Reloaded II Mod Loader
- Add Lego Batman to Reloaded II either through setup or by clicking the + on the left.
  - Must use the exe found in the Steam Lego Batman folder
- Navigate to the "Mods" folder in wherever you installed Reloaded II
- Move the LB1_AP_Mod folder into the Reloaded II Mods folder
- --
## Connecting to a Multiworld
- In Reloaded II, select the LB1 Archipelago Mod and click "Configure Mod"
- Fill out the Host IP, Port Number, Slot Name, and Password as applicable
- Ensure that the Archipelago Mod is enabled
  - Indicated by the red +
- Launch the game in Reloaded II
- The game will attempt to connect to the server once the menu is loaded
- IT IS IMPORTANT THAT YOU WAIT ON THE MENU UNTIL IT IS CONNECTED
- Start a new game and enjoy
- --

notes.text:
# LB1 AP Re-release

## New features
- Characters & Suits have been added as items and locations in the APWorld
    - Options to shuffle Ras & Hush and customize the number of minikits/hostages needed (items)
    - Options to simplify the logic for Characters that require a whole hero episode (nightwing, etc.) or all hero episodes (bat tank)
- Minikit Grouping - Minikits can now be grouped in packs of 1, 2, 5, or 10
- Cheaper Shops - you can now lower shop prices 
- Options to customize how many multipliers are needed for shop purchases based on price (after the effects of cheaper shops)
- Option to start with Power Brick & Minikit Detectors
- Rewrote logic to use Rule Builder so it is now compatible with the /explain function in UT
    - A map pack for UT is being worked on
- Purple stud support
- A few minor name rewording & cleanup 
- Please note that due to initial playtesting, power bricks and character tokens are coupled and not decoupled. That means you have to collect the character or power brick in level and then purchase it for 1 check. There consequently will only be 1 item (Character/Power brick unlocked)
- Please note that logic only takes Freeplay into consideration. Story mode is not considered in logic ever.

There have been multiple versions of this release over the past year trying to fix bugs so if I missed any new features or updates, I apologize.
